subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The wise man went to the king next day and begged seven years for the job. The king gave him the horse and also seven years. (b) The wise man went home sadly because the king threatened him to kill if he failed. He did not know what to do. (c) Once there was a foolish king. He had a white horse. The king also had a wise friend whom everyone liked. (d) His daughter advised him to go to the king and beg seven years because teaching a horse to speak needed long time. She also suggested that anything might happen in seven years. (e) The king was angry because he wanted that people should like him instead of the wise man. (f) Before the end of the seven years the floolis king died and the wise man kept the horse. (g) One day he called the seven wise man and asked him to teach his white horse to speak. (h) When he reached home his daugher asked him why he looked so sad. He told everything to his daughter.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
